summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist (four parameters, full type hints, Google-style docstring) and private helpers. Added an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py. Added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities automodule. Added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist and the four specified tests. Lines measured under 120 characters in all three Python files. Tests and black were not run, per instructions. Changes are uncommitted. One addition beyond the spec: a non-list value under the data_list_key raises ValueError.
